# Naitrust

Naitrust is building escrow payments for buyers and sellers in Nigeria. Agree terms, track evidence and approve release. Join early access.

## Product

A Protected Deal connects agreed terms, participant and beneficiary checks, funding status, evidence, approvals and payment release in one shared Deal Room. It is designed for purchases, services, deposits and business payments.

Buyers can review what was agreed and the evidence before release. Sellers can see confirmed funding and document delivery or completed work. Both sides share the record used to review an issue.

## Availability

Naitrust is accepting early access interest. Existing invited users can sign in. Payment services are not yet open to the public. Join the waiting list for launch updates.

## Payment boundaries

Naitrust does not directly hold customer funds, operate as a bank or claim its own escrow licence. Appropriately licensed providers must handle custody and money movement. Provider details, fees and applicable terms will be disclosed before live payments.

Verification records specified checks, not a guarantee of delivery, quality or future conduct. Reporting an issue alone does not automatically freeze a payment. Evidence and applicable risk controls determine the review process.
